subject: Renewal & Expansion: pricing step-ups, blended rates, adding new routes/models
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zeta-finance.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@zeta-finance.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — token volumes & budget

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call today — that was helpful. Quick recap from our side and a few qualification items so we can move toward a concrete quote:

- Current usage: ~12M tokens/month (mostly short chat responses).
- Projected 1yr growth: targeting 3x to ~36M tokens/month as we add two new customer-facing routes (support summarization and in-app recommendations).
- Models: currently using a mix of open LLMs + a small specialized 7B for recommendations. We want the ability to route to different models by route.
- Budget: we have a rough budget range for the renewal + expansion but want to understand target unit economics — specifically target $/1M tokens for blended usage across routes.

Can you send a post-call pricing recap with: 1) a few renewal vs committed volume step-up options, 2) blended $/1M token targets for each option, and 3) notes on how adding routes/models will impact blended rates?

Also looping in Maya on procurement timing — we expect procurement to start mid-Dec and aim to sign in January if the numbers make sense.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Turner
Sr. Product Manager, Zeta Finance
alex.turner@zeta-finance.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zeta-finwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — pricing options & step-ups

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Attached is a concise quote + an example MAAP step-up CSV with blended rate modeling (attachments: redwood_pricing_quote_v3.pdf, MAAP_stepups_example.csv, Zeta_2026_usage_projection.xlsx). High-level answers below — happy to iterate.

1) Renewal vs committed step-up options (monthly tokens)
   - Option A (Renewal, no commit): pay-as-you-go; blended baseline ~ $1,200 / 1M tokens for current model mix; volume discounts trigger at 50M+ monthly.
   - Option B (Moderate commit): 36M committed / month (12-month term) — blended $/1M tokens: ~$850, with step-ups at 50M ( $760 ), 100M ( $650 ).
   - Option C (Aggressive commit): 75M committed / month — blended $/1M tokens: ~$700, step-ups to $590 at 150M.

2) How blended $/1M is computed and unit econ notes
   - Blended $/1M = (sum over routes of (route_token_volume * route_unit_rate)) / total_tokens * 1,000,000.
   - Key drivers: model mix (large models cost more per token), average response length (tokens/response), and prefix/cache reuse.
   - Example from the attached projection: moving the recommendations route to a 7B quantized runtime reduces that route's unit cost ~25%, improving blended rates overall.

3) Adding routes / model routing impact
   - Adding lightweight routes (short responses, quantized models) tends to lower blended $/1M; heavy generative routes (long responses, large models) increase it.
   - We support per-route routing policies so you can pin expensive LLMs to specific routes and keep cheaper models for others. The quote includes blended scenarios for the two new routes you described.

4) Next steps / timeline
   - If procurement starts mid-Dec, I recommend we finalize committed volumes by Dec 10 to allow internal approvals.
   - I'll prepare a short mutual action plan (MAP) and send a DocuSign link for a draft commitment once you confirm which option (A/B/C) you prefer.

Let me know which option you want modeled against your internal budget and I can run a final blended table and a two-sided MAP.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: redwood_pricing_quote_v3.pdf (quote), MAAP_stepups_example.csv (step-up modeling), Zeta_2026_usage_projection.xlsx (your usage input)
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zeta-finance.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@zeta-finance.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — pricing options & step-ups

Marissa — really helpful summary, thanks. A few follow-ups from procurement/product: 

- Our procurement team will push back on any commit that locks us to models we might replace mid-term. Can you confirm whether the committed tiers allow us to change model routes (e.g., swap the specialized 7B for a newer 6B) without renegotiating pricing?
- For our internal budget review we need a target blended $/1M tokens for the two committed scenarios (36M and 75M) that assumes: recommendations route on a quantized 7B, support summarization on a cheaper 3B quantized, and the rest on open LLMs. Can you provide those two blended numbers (single $/1M each)?
- On blended rates: do you offer a blended floor if we add new routes mid-term, or would the addition shift us into a higher tier? Ideally procurement wants predictability (e.g., a blended floor or commit top-up process).

If you can get back with the two target numbers and language about model swap flexibility and top-up process, we can surface to procurement next week. Also, if you can draft a 1-page MAP (milestones + owner + timing) and a DocuSign draft, that will speed approvals.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zeta-finance.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — pricing options & step-ups

Alex — quick answers and attached MAP + updated quote with the two blended numbers you requested (see redwood_pricing_quote_v3.pdf). Summary below so procurement has a single-page answer.

- Model swap flexibility: Yes — committed tiers are tied to token volumes, not a fixed model list. You may change model routing mid-term. If the new model materially increases costs (e.g., switching to a much larger, non-quantized model), we would propose a good-faith adjustment but we do not require a full contract renegotiation for routine swaps. I'll have legal add standard language to the draft.

- Blended $/1M estimates (assumes recommendations=7B quantized, support=3B quantized, rest=open LLMs):
   - 36M committed / month: blended ~ $820 / 1M tokens.
   - 75M committed / month: blended ~ $695 / 1M tokens.

- Blended floor / top-up process: We can include a blended floor for the initial 12-month term (protects you from adding high-cost routes pushing the blended above an agreed cap). If usage exceeds committed volumes, we offer a simple top-up pricing schedule (you pay overage at the next tier's blended rate or can purchase an immediate commit top-up at a mutually agreed rate). Details are in the attached quote.

Attachments included: redwood_pricing_quote_v3.pdf (updated), MAAP_stepups_example.csv (modeled scenarios), Zeta_2026_usage_projection.xlsx (annotated).

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm which commit option (B or C) you'd like modeled as the primary quote by Dec 3.
- I'll send a one-page MAP + DocuSign draft by Dec 7 for procurement review.
- Quick sync call with Marcus (CS) to discuss routing/implementation details — Marcus is available next week (CC'd).

I'll also add the legal flexibility language to the DocuSign draft. Let me know if you want different blended assumptions and I'll rerun the model.

Best,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
